domain: Organizational Psychology / Ethics of Expertise / Systems of Complicity
topic_summary: Analysis of a generated narrative depicting three characters trapped by their own competencies within a system that converts excellence into complicity. A neural enhancement specialist builds unauthorized improvements, an enhanced worker gains pattern recognition that compels action, and a security chief maintains order by suppressing evidence. Each character's capability becomes the mechanism of their entrapment.

key_entities: Dr. Amara Okonkwo (neural enhancement specialist; builds beyond specifications)
Tala Mora (recycling plant worker; receives unauthorized enhancements)
Security Chief Park (twenty-year veteran; maintains order through documentation)
Kepler Station Administration (enforcement authority; executes Lian Zhao)
The Enhancement Architecture (seventeen unauthorized improvements; pattern recognition optimization)
key_tensions: Capability vs agency (characters can see/do more but cannot choose not to)
Excellence vs complicity (superior performance enables systemic harm)
Pattern recognition vs action (seeing clearly does not determine response)
key_mechanisms: Unauthorized enhancement (Okonkwo adds seventeen improvements beyond contract)
Compulsive pattern recognition (Tala's enhanced architecture forces continuous analysis)
Evidence suppression (Park deletes investigation to preserve routine)
key_absences: No external intervention or oversight (system is closed)
No collective resistance (each character acts alone)

axes.human_readable: Capability-Compulsion Gradient (Excellence as Loss of Refusal)
axes.structural_delta: Increasing competence reduces capacity to refuse deployment of that competence
axes.primary_observable: Behavioral autonomy measured against skill level; frequency of 'could not not do' framings
axes.selection_reason: Upstream mountain providing physical constraint base; different observable from other axes (behavioral autonomy vs system position vs cognitive load)

axes.human_readable: Optimization as Entrapment (Enhancement Converts Agency to Compulsion)
axes.structural_delta: Improving a system's performance characteristics can eliminate the operator's ability to choose non-optimal actions
axes.primary_observable: Decision latency metrics; presence/absence of deliberation before action; 'reflex not choice' self-reports
axes.selection_reason: Highest centrality; downstream synthesis node; tangled_rope with clear beneficiary/victim structure

axes.human_readable: Complicity Through Competence (Doing One's Job Well as Systemic Harm)
axes.structural_delta: Professional excellence in role performance can constitute participation in harm without requiring moral agreement
axes.primary_observable: Performance metrics vs ethical outcomes; maintenance of routine despite visible harm; suppression of evidence to preserve role
axes.selection_reason: Highest centrality; terminal synthesis node; snare with institutional beneficiary; captures Park's deletion as structural rather than moral failure

axes.selection_reason: Deferred: captured indirectly via optimization_as_entrapment (Tala's enhanced pattern recognition is the mechanism of her compulsion); lower structural distinctiveness than selected axes

omegas.description: Why do all three characters act alone? Is collective action structurally unavailable (no coordination mechanism) or psychologically unavailable (competence isolates)? If the latter, complicity_through_competence may be Snare of individuated excellence rather than institutional continuity.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) + extraction_summary key_absences

omegas.description: Can Tala's enhancements be removed? If yes, optimization_as_entrapment is Rope (coordination problem). If no, it's Piton (atrophied capacity). Narrative implies irreversibility but does not confirm.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) + optimization_as_entrapment classification

omegas.description: Is capability_compulsion_gradient a true Mountain (neurological/physical constraint on refusal) or Piton of cultural conditioning? Narrative shows Okonkwo's hands moving 'without conscious direction' but does not establish whether this is biological necessity or learned behavior.

The narrative depicts a closed system with no external intervention. Is this closure structural (Kepler Station is isolated) or narrative convenience? If structural, all three axes operate within bounded context. If convenience, axes may not generalize beyond closed systems.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) + extraction_summary key_absences

fracture_scan.notes: F03 detected: capability_compulsion_gradient classified as mountain but narrative evidence is ambiguous between neurological constraint and cultural conditioning. Generated omega_mountain_validity to bound this uncertainty. All three selected axes share 'competence as trap' structure but operate at different levels (individual capability, system optimization, institutional role) with different observables and beneficiary structures, passing independence test.
